layers.label: Intake
layers.purpose: Clarify platform, audience, deliverable, source material, and acceptance gates.

layers.label: Evidence
layers.purpose: Gather sources, examples, screenshots, analytics, or user-provided material.

layers.label: Strategy
layers.purpose: Choose positioning, audience angle, content mix, and operating approach.

layers.label: Creation
layers.purpose: Create topics, hooks, outlines, drafts, edits, scripts, and voice polish.

layers.label: Packaging
layers.purpose: Create covers, cards, thumbnails, screenshots, generated images, and visual systems.

layers.label: Manual Handoff
layers.purpose: Prepare publish-ready packages without platform login automation.

layers.label: Measurement
layers.purpose: Review performance, diagnose patterns, and choose next experiments.

layers.label: Systems
layers.purpose: Build reusable content libraries, calendars, operating docs, and knowledge bases.

stages.purpose: Clarify deliverable, audience, platform, and source materials.
Gather or verify source evidence and public examples.
Choose positioning, content angle, and operating approach.
Generate or select topics and outlines.
Create titles, hooks, openings, and first-screen copy.
Edit for clarity, human voice, platform fit, and AI-pattern cleanup.
Define visual concept, cover, card, thumbnail, or screenshot direction.
Generate images, cards, thumbnails, screenshots, or slide assets.
Render card, carousel, slide, screenshot, or image files for handoff.
Prepare publish-ready manual package and checklist.
Analyze performance and recommend next experiments.
Build reusable content workflows, libraries, and operating docs.

skills.name: anysearch
skills.use_when: Current public facts, competitor examples, market signals, or source links are needed.
skills.install_hint: Install a public-search or research skill; anysearch is the recommended default.

skills.name: niche-research
skills.use_when: The user needs niche, competitor, audience, or demand research before content creation.
skills.install_hint: Useful for strategy-heavy creator or market research workflows.

skills.name: post-writer
skills.use_when: The user needs a LinkedIn-style, essay-style, or social post draft.
skills.install_hint: Recommended primary writing skill for social posts.

skills.name: post-formatter
skills.use_when: A draft needs platform-ready formatting and final structure.
skills.install_hint: Recommended for final social copy packaging.

skills.name: hook-generator
skills.use_when: The key task is hooks, openings, or first-line variants.

skills.name: xhs-visual-director
skills.use_when: A Xiaohongshu/Rednote visual concept, cover direction, or image plan is needed.

skills.name: guizang-social-card-skill
skills.use_when: The output should be a designed social card, carousel, or shareable visual card.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.use_when: The user needs raster image generation or editing.

skills.name: high-fidelity-page-screenshot
skills.use_when: The user asks for full-page, prototype, demo, or shareable page screenshots.

skills.name: humanizer-zh
skills.use_when: Chinese copy needs to sound more human and less AI-generated.

skills.name: graphic-designer
skills.use_when: The user needs platform-neutral visual direction or social graphics rather than Xiaohongshu-specific art direction.
skills.install_hint: Recommended for general social graphics and visual direction.

skills.name: analytics-dashboard
skills.use_when: The user provides analytics exports and needs diagnosis, dashboard, or next actions.

skills.name: notion-knowledge-capture
skills.use_when: The output should become a reusable knowledge or content operating system.
skills.install_hint: Recommended when Notion is part of the workflow.

pipelines.label: Turn notes into a platform-ready social post

stages.agent_role: Router clarifies platform, audience, source notes, and final format.
Hook agent explores openings when a social post needs a strong first screen.
Writing agent turns source notes and the selected hook into the main post.
Editing agent formats and polishes the draft for the target platform.
Handoff agent prepares final copy, metadata, and manual publish checklist.
Router confirms topic, audience, note type, source material, and asset requirements.
Hook agent explores title and first-screen variants.
Visual agent defines the cover or card direction.
Writing agent drafts the note body from the selected angle.
Asset agent selects one renderer for the required cover or card assets.
Editing agent tightens the body copy for Xiaohongshu reading behavior.
Handoff agent assembles title, body, tags, asset list, and manual publish checklist.

pipelines.label: Research and write an evidence-backed article or newsletter

stages.agent_role: Research agent selects the best available evidence workflow and gathers sources without inventing facts.
Strategy agent selects the topic and article angle from evidence.
Writing agent drafts the article or newsletter.
Editing agent formats and polishes the piece.
Handoff agent lists sources, final copy, metadata, and publish checklist.

pipelines.label: Create or prepare visual assets for content

stages.agent_role: Visual direction agent defines format, hierarchy, style, and acceptance checks.
Asset agent selects one renderer that matches the requested deliverable.
Router inventories files, captions, alt text, and manual publish notes.
Strategy agent defines audience, pillars, cadence, and operating assumptions.
Measurement agent reviews available performance data and experiment signals.
Systems agent turns strategy and metrics into reusable docs, databases, and workflows.
